source_quote.quote: Identification of molecular genetic alterations based on molecular characterisation (WES and RNASeq) of tumor at diagnosis, then under standard anti-cancer treatment

coder_notes: Registered phase NA (fails S3 by code). Multi-cohort molecular profiling programme; the only registered intervention is blood/tumour sampling. Patients receive standard-of-care therapies chosen outside the study (e.g. radiochemotherapy for glioblastoma, dabrafenib+trametinib, selpercatinib, imatinib), which are eligibility context, not registered interventions, so no agents are listed. Treatment setting coded for the glioblastoma cohort (enrolled before standard radiochemotherapy); other cohorts include relapsed/recurrent disease. BRAF/RET/MSI biomarkers define non-GBM cohorts only.
